# Tests

This layer contains test files for various common utilities and data structures used throughout the project.

## Responsibilities

- **Data Structures Testing**: Validates the functionality of data structures like binary heaps, queues, and URLs.

| [`packages/common/src/appEventBus.test.ts`](../../../packages/common/src/appEventBus.test.ts) | Tests the appEventBus functionality. | `flushMicrotasks` |

| [`packages/common/tests/url.test.tsx`](../../../packages/common/tests/url.test.tsx) | Tests the URL normalization utility. |  |

## How it works

The files in this layer work together to test the core components of the project. For example, `appEventBus.test.ts` tests the `appEventBus` functionality, while `binary-heap.test.ts` tests the `BinaryHeap` class.
